description: Quote adding collateral ('push', requires leverage) or withdrawing it ('pull'). Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

amount.description: Collateral to add or withdraw, in base units

leverage.description: Target leverage as a plain number between 1 and 100: 3 means 3x (not 1e18 fixed-point)

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)

name: quote_adjust
title: Quote adjust
